title: Malus Month
text: Six accounting periods of a transport contract as the transport authority's contract manager, alone. Each month the operator's incident list is on your desk: for each class of incidents, what is paid and what a penalty applies to. The operator objects now and then. Deduct too much and it runs out of money; too little and the auditor finds it, and the quality slides.
debrief: Train-km cancelled for an infrastructure fault: paid or not, penalty or not, and why?
Which objection did you accept, and what made it justified?
What would six months of full penalties on everything have done to the operator, and to the passengers?
